summary: Inline round 8 review: all three round 7 blocking findings are resolved, and the previously resolved safeguards remain intact. One newly reproduced pagination defect permits unbounded authenticated requests despite the research sample cap. TypeScript validation passed; no live Instagram calls were made.

prior_blockers.title: HTML account-stop responses below HTTP 500 still erase pending protection
prior_blockers.evidence: publish.ts:460 now requires an error body identifying a JSON answer before clearing pending state at publish.ts:463. Non-JSON errors omit that body (client.ts:287). Offline reproductions with HTTP 200, 403 and 404 HTML retained pending records, made one configure request, and blocked subsequent publishing. Paths: instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/publish.ts:460; instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/client.ts:287.

prior_blockers.title: A 5xx transcode-shaped response triggers automatic configure retries
prior_blockers.evidence: The retry predicate requires a JSON transcode_pending error with HTTP status below 500 (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/publish.ts:385). Offline execution with a video plan and HTTP 502 containing status=in_progress made exactly one configure request and retained pending protection.

prior_blockers.title: HTML feedback and wait signals still allow authenticated fallback
prior_blockers.evidence: Feedback and wait markers are checked in both HTML handling paths before ordinary response classification (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/client.ts:261; instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/client.ts:278). Offline reproductions confirmed each signal stopped after the first request with both expectJson settings.

prior_blockers.title: Recursive Chrome-profile isolation still fails open
prior_blockers.evidence: Nonempty-profile reset failures and recursive ACL inspection failures return failure (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/secure.ts:88; instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/secure.ts:103). Authentication requires recursive isolation before launching Chrome (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/auth.ts:240). Native ACL mutation was not exercised.

prior_blockers.title: Overlapping manual unlocks can delete an active publisher's lock
prior_blockers.evidence: Claims have unique filenames, exclusive creation, and owner-specific release; stale cleanup skips potentially live owners (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/pending.ts:97; instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/pending.ts:101; instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/pending.ts:129). Offline checks confirmed competing acquisition fails and unlock preserves the live claim.

prior_blockers.title: Non-JSON response classification permits unsafe fallback and clears ambiguous publishes
prior_blockers.evidence: Account markers precede non-JSON not_found classification, and publish recovery now distinguishes JSON answers from HTML (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/client.ts:274; instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/publish.ts:460). Offline checks confirmed stop behavior and retained pending records.

prior_blockers.title: Explicit false confirmation flags execute mutations
prior_blockers.evidence: False/0 assignments remove boolean switches, while other unsupported values throw (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/main.ts:92). Offline parsing confirmed --confirm=false and --experimental=0 remain unset. Mutation gates precede client creation (main.ts:145; main.ts:358).

strengths: Authenticated requests enforce HTTPS and the configured Instagram hostname allowlist, with redirects disabled. Origin overrides preserve the Instagram domain boundary; GraphQL bundle fetches attach no cookies (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/client.ts:214; client.ts:236; constants.ts:27; graphql.ts:85). Offline host-refusal checks passed.

CLI write paths return before client creation without --confirm, and every current write contract requires --experimental. Offline dry-run and gate checks made zero fetches; valid reel preparation was inspected statically (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/main.ts:140; main.ts:145; main.ts:354; main.ts:358; publish.ts:23).

Cookie replacement locks an empty temporary file before writing credentials. Storage failures throw unless the explicit insecure-storage override is enabled; an offline mocked ACL failure confirmed rejection (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/cookie-store.ts:120; cookie-store.ts:126; secure.ts:113; secure.ts:118).

Publish locking, unreadable/corrupt-ledger handling, and write-ahead records preserve uncertainty. HTML, 5xx, network failures and missing media IDs retain protection; candidate matching never resolves records automatically (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/pending.ts:95; pending.ts:143; pending.ts:151; publish.ts:450; publish.ts:460; publish.ts:476; main.ts:383).

Automatic configure retries are limited to explicit JSON transcode-pending responses below HTTP 500 for video plans, with ten attempts total. Delete/comment fallback requires HTTP 404; ambiguous mutation responses stop (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/publish.ts:385; client.ts:317).

Routine session output and publish descriptions redact credentials. Account-stop signals propagate through probe and research; no like, follow or DM commands exist. Default authenticated-request pacing is 1500 ms, with an environment override (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/main.ts:221; main.ts:246; main.ts:316; publish.ts:313; client.ts:111; constants.ts:54).

blocking_findings.title: Post pagination can issue unbounded authenticated requests without making progress
blocking_findings.why: The post limit bounds accumulated results, not requests. An empty page advertising continuation passes validation and leaves the loop running indefinitely, including when the cursor repeats. This can drive sustained account traffic until Instagram imposes a restriction, undermining the intended bounded research behavior.
blocking_findings.evidence: REST pagination accepts any items array and continues whenever more_available and next_max_id are present, without detecting an empty page or repeated cursor. GraphQL pagination has the equivalent gap for empty edges and repeated end_cursor. An offline getPosts(client, null, 6) reproduction repeatedly returned items=[], more_available=true and next_max_id='same'; it made five requests and stopped only because the fifth response was an injected 429. No live Instagram behavior is asserted.

open_questions: No live Instagram calls were made. Payload acceptance, actual restriction-page formats, transcode semantics and deletion behavior remain unverified; all write contracts currently retain their experimental gate.

Bun was unavailable on PATH. The full unit suite was not run because it creates filesystem fixtures in this read-only environment. TypeScript --noEmit passed; runtime checks used Node TypeScript transformation with synthetic credentials and mocked filesystem/network operations.
Native Windows ACL mutation and Chrome-profile reuse were not exercised. Storage conclusions combine source inspection with mocked failure checks.

Malformed-cookie diagnostics remain unverified under Bun. JSON parsing errors flow into logged or printed error messages without explicit sanitization (instagram-ai-plugin/skills/instagram/scripts/cookie-store.ts:61; cookie-store.ts:112; main.ts:404; main.ts:407).

Live acceptance still permits an empty posts array without asserting via or pagination, and deletion verification checks absence from six feed results without establishing completeness (instagram-ai-plugin/test/live.test.ts:36; live.test.ts:38; live.test.ts:71).
